title: Private lab effects verified by others

tellings.quote: There are things that I've seen in private laboratories that are undeniable and verified by people other than myself in those facilities.

plain: Dave Rossi, a man who says aliens taught him advanced physics, says he has seen things in private laboratories that are undeniable. He says other people working in those facilities verified them too, not just him. If true, it would mean the physics he describes produces real, checkable effects.
